                .nodes
                .get(&parent)
                .with_context(|| format!("parent inode {parent} does not exist"))?;
            if !matches!(parent_node.kind, NodeKind::Directory) {
                bail!("parent {} is not a directory", parent_node.path);
            }
            let path = if parent_node.path == "/" {
                format!("/{name}")
            } else {
                format!("{}/{}", parent_node.path, name)
            };
            if self.paths.contains_key(&path) {
                bail!("duplicate namespace path {path}");
            }
            let ino = inode_for_path(&path);
            if let Some(existing) = self.namespace.nodes.get(&ino) {
                bail!("inode collision between {} and {path}", existing.path);
            }
            let node = Node {
                ino,
                parent,
                name: OsString::from(name),
                path: path.clone(),
                kind,
                write_target,
            };
            if matches!(node.kind, NodeKind::Directory) {
                self.namespace.children.insert(ino, BTreeMap::new());
            }
            self.namespace
                .children
                .entry(parent)
                .or_default()
                .insert(node.name.clone(), ino);
            self.namespace.nodes.insert(ino, node);
            self.paths.insert(path, ino);
            Ok(ino)
        }
    
        fn finish(self) -> Namespace {
            self.namespace
        }
    }
    
    fn object_hash_for_target(
        view: &ViewManifest,
        workspace: Option<&Workspace>,
        plugin_id: &str,
    ) -> Result<String> {
        workspace
            .and_then(|workspace| workspace.staged_objects.get(plugin_id))
            .or_else(|| view.objects.get(plugin_id))
            .cloned()
            .with_context(|| format!("missing object hash for plugin '{plugin_id}'"))
    }
    
    fn write_target(
        workspace_id: Option<&str>,
        plugin_id: &str,
        pointer: &str,
        writable: bool,
    ) -> Option<WriteTarget> {
        if !writable {
            return None;
        }
        Some(WriteTarget {
            workspace_id: workspace_id?.to_string(),
            plugin_id: plugin_id.to_string(),
            pointer: pointer.to_string(),
        })
    }
    
    fn pointer_is_immutable(
        schema: Option<&PluginSchema>,
        pointer: &str,
        field: Option<&FieldSchema>,
        _root_value: &Value,
    ) -> bool {
        let Some(schema) = schema else {
            return false;
        };
        if field.is_some_and(|field| field.read_only) {
            return true;
        }
        // Conditional writability depends on a sibling in the full plugin value.
        // Keep such leaves read-only in the direct file projection; whole-state
        // staging can still evaluate the condition accurately.
        if field.is_some_and(|field| field.read_only_when.is_some()) {
            return true;
        }
        schema
            .immutable_paths
            .iter()
            .any(|immutable| pointer == immutable || pointer.starts_with(&format!("{immutable}/")))
    }
    
    fn field_for_pointer<'a>(
        plugin_schema: Option<&'a PluginSchema>,
        parent: Option<&'a FieldSchema>,
        name: &str,
    ) -> Option<&'a FieldSchema> {
        fn object_field<'a>(field_type: &'a FieldType, name: &str) -> Option<&'a FieldSchema> {
            match field_type {
                FieldType::Object(fields) => fields.get(name),
                FieldType::Array(item) => object_field(item, name),
                _ => None,
            }
        }
    
        match parent.and_then(|field| object_field(&field.field_type, name)) {
            Some(field) => Some(field),
            None if parent.is_none() => plugin_schema.and_then(|schema| schema.fields.get(name)),
            None => None,
        }
    }
    
    fn push_pointer(parent: &str, segment: &str) -> String {
        let escaped = segment.replace('~', "~0").replace('/', "~1");
        format!("{parent}/{escaped}")
    }
    
    pub fn encode_component(value: &str) -> String {
        let mut output = String::new();
        for byte in value.bytes() {
            if byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(byte, b'.' | b'_' | b'-') {
                output.push(byte as char);
            } else {
                output.push_str(&format!("%{byte:02X}"));
            }
        }
        if output == "." || output == ".." || output.is_empty() {
            format!("%{}", hex_bytes(value.as_bytes()))
        } else {
            output
        }
    }
    
    fn hex_bytes(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
        bytes.iter().map(|byte| format!("{byte:02X}")).collect()
    }
    
    fn inode_for_path(path: &str) -> u64 {
        let bytes = blake3::hash(path.as_bytes()).as_bytes()[..8]
            .try_into()
            .expect("eight-byte slice");
        let mut ino = u64::from_le_bytes(bytes) | (1 << 63);
        if ino == ROOT_INO {
            ino += 1;
        }
        ino
    }
    
    #[cfg(test)]
    mod tests {
        use super::*;
    
        #[test]
        fn invocation_reference_requires_the_plugin_in_the_pinned_view() {
            let mut view = ViewManifest {
                format: "3tchedfs/1".into(),
                view_id: "test-view".into(),
                source_catalog_hash: "test-catalog".into(),
                source_catalog_generation: 1,
                parent_view: None,
                objects: BTreeMap::new(),
            };
            let metadata = |view: &ViewManifest| {
                let mut builder =
                    NamespaceBuilder::new(ProjectionTarget::View(view.view_id.clone()), None, false);
                builder.add_root_metadata(view, None).unwrap();
                let ino = builder.namespace.children[&ROOT_INO][&OsString::from(".3tchedfs.json")];
                let NodeKind::File(bytes) = &builder.namespace.nodes[&ino].kind else {
                    panic!("mount metadata must be a projected file");
                };
                serde_json::from_slice::<Value>(&bytes.read()).unwrap()
            };
            assert!(metadata(&view).get("invocation").is_none());
            view.objects
                .insert("threetched_fs".into(), "sealed-object-hash".into());
            assert_eq!(
                metadata(&view)["invocation"],
                "/plugins/threetched_fs/data/invocation/.value.json"
            );
            view.objects.remove("threetched_fs");
            view.objects
                .insert("unrelated".into(), "other-object-hash".into());
            assert!(metadata(&view).get("invocation").is_none());
        }
    
        #[test]
        fn encoding_is_path_safe_and_deterministic() {
            assert_eq!(encode_component("hello_world-1.0"), "hello_world-1.0");
            assert_eq!(encode_component("cap:test@v1"), "cap%3Atest%40v1");
            assert_eq!(encode_component(".."), "%2E2E");
        }
    
        #[test]
        fn path_inodes_are_stable() {
            assert_eq!(
                inode_for_path("/plugins/demo"),
                inode_for_path("/plugins/demo")
            );
            assert_ne!(
                inode_for_path("/plugins/demo"),
                inode_for_path("/plugins/other")
            );
        }
    }
    use std::collections::BTreeMap;
    use std::fs::{self, File, OpenOptions};
    use std::io::Write;
    use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
    
    use anyhow::{Context, Result, bail};
    use fs2::FileExt;
    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
    use serde_json::Value;
    use uuid::Uuid;
    
    use crate::model::{FORMAT_VERSION, TypedObjectBlob};
    use crate::source::{SourceCatalog, SourceSnapshot};
    
    pub const DEFAULT_STORE_DIR: &str = "/dev/shm/3tchedfs";
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
    pub struct ViewManifest {
        pub format: String,
        pub view_id: String,
        pub source_catalog_hash: String,
        pub source_catalog_generation: u64,
        pub parent_view: Option<String>,
        pub objects: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    }
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
    struct ViewBody {
        format: String,
        source_catalog_hash: String,
        source_catalog_generation: u64,
        parent_view: Option<String>,
        objects: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    }
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
    pub struct Workspace {
        pub format: String,
        pub workspace_id: String,
        pub base_view: String,
        pub staged_objects: BTreeMap<String, String>,
        pub committed_view: Option<String>,
    }
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
    pub struct ObjectStore {
        root: PathBuf,
    }
    
    impl ObjectStore {
        pub fn open(root: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> Result<Self> {
            let store = Self { root: root.into() };
            for directory in [
                store.objects_dir(),
                store.views_dir(),
                store.workspaces_dir(),
                store.snapshots_dir(),
            ] {
                fs::create_dir_all(&directory)
                    .with_context(|| format!("create store directory {}", directory.display()))?;
            }
            Ok(store)
        }
    
        pub fn capture(&self, source: &SourceCatalog, activate: bool) -> Result<ViewManifest> {
            let snapshot = source.capture()?;
            self.capture_snapshot(snapshot, activate)
        }
    
        pub fn capture_snapshot(
            &self,
            snapshot: SourceSnapshot,
            activate: bool,
        ) -> Result<ViewManifest> {
            let _lock = self.lock_exclusive()?;
            let mut objects = BTreeMap::new();
            for (plugin_id, object) in snapshot.objects {
                let hash = self.write_object(&object)?;
                objects.insert(plugin_id, hash);
            }
    
            if let Some(current) = self.current_view().transpose()?
                && current.source_catalog_hash == snapshot.catalog_hash
                && current.source_catalog_generation == snapshot.catalog_generation
                && current.objects == objects
            {
                return Ok(current);
            }
    
            let parent_view = self.current_view_id()?;
            let body = ViewBody {
                format: FORMAT_VERSION.to_string(),
                source_catalog_hash: snapshot.catalog_hash,
                source_catalog_generation: snapshot.catalog_generation,
                parent_view,
                objects,
            };
            let view = self.write_view(body)?;
            if activate {
                self.set_current(&view.view_id)?;
            }
            Ok(view)
        }
    
        pub fn create_workspace(
            &self,
            workspace_id: Option<&str>,
            base_view: Option<&str>,
        ) -> Result<Workspace> {
            let _lock = self.lock_exclusive()?;
            let id = workspace_id
                .map(ToOwned::to_owned)
                .unwrap_or_else(|| Uuid::new_v4().to_string());
            validate_name(&id, "workspace")?;
            let base_view = match base_view {
                Some(id) => {
                    self.read_view(id)?;
                    id.to_string()
                }
                None => self
                    .current_view_id()?
                    .context("no current view; capture the SHM source first")?,
            };
            let workspace = Workspace {
                format: FORMAT_VERSION.to_string(),
                workspace_id: id.clone(),
                base_view,
                staged_objects: BTreeMap::new(),
                committed_view: None,
            };
            let path = self.workspace_path(&id);
            if path.exists() {
                bail!("workspace '{id}' already exists");
            }
            self.atomic_json(&path, &workspace)?;
            Ok(workspace)
        }
    
        pub fn read_workspace(&self, id: &str) -> Result<Workspace> {
            validate_name(id, "workspace")?;
            self.read_json(self.workspace_path(id))
        }
    
        fn stage_state_locked(
            &self,
            mut workspace: Workspace,
            plugin_id: &str,
            value: Value,
        ) -> Result<String> {
            if workspace.committed_view.is_some() {
                bail!(
                    "workspace '{}' is already committed",
                    workspace.workspace_id
                );
            }
            let current_object = self.workspace_object(&workspace, plugin_id)?;
            let base_view = self.read_view(&workspace.base_view)?;
            let immutable_base = self.object_for_view(&base_view, plugin_id)?;
            let object = TypedObjectBlob::new(
                plugin_id.to_string(),
                current_object.source_schema_hash.clone(),
                current_object.schema.clone(),
                value,
            )?;
            object.validate(Some(&immutable_base.value))?;
            let hash = self.write_object(&object)?;
            workspace
                .staged_objects
                .insert(plugin_id.to_string(), hash.clone());
            self.atomic_json(&self.workspace_path(&workspace.workspace_id), &workspace)?;
            Ok(hash)
        }
    
        pub fn stage_pointer(
            &self,
            workspace_id: &str,
            plugin_id: &str,
            pointer: &str,
            value: Value,
        ) -> Result<String> {
            let _lock = self.lock_exclusive()?;
            let workspace = self.read_workspace(workspace_id)?;
            let object = self.workspace_object(&workspace, plugin_id)?;
            let mut state = object.value;
            set_json_pointer(&mut state, pointer, value)?;
            self.stage_state_locked(workspace, plugin_id, state)
        }
    
        pub fn commit_workspace(&self, workspace_id: &str, activate: bool) -> Result<ViewManifest> {
            let _lock = self.lock_exclusive()?;
            let mut workspace = self.read_workspace(workspace_id)?;
            if let Some(view_id) = &workspace.committed_view {
                return self.read_view(view_id);
            }
            if activate && self.current_view_id()?.as_deref() != Some(workspace.base_view.as_str()) {
                bail!(
                    "workspace base {} is stale; current view changed",
                    workspace.base_view
                );
            }
            let base = self.read_view(&workspace.base_view)?;
            let mut objects = base.objects.clone();
            objects.extend(workspace.staged_objects.clone());
            let body = ViewBody {
                format: FORMAT_VERSION.to_string(),
                source_catalog_hash: base.source_catalog_hash,
                source_catalog_generation: base.source_catalog_generation,
                parent_view: Some(base.view_id.clone()),
                objects,
            };
            let view = self.write_view(body)?;
            if activate {
                self.set_current(&view.view_id)?;
            }
            workspace.committed_view = Some(view.view_id.clone());
            self.atomic_json(&self.workspace_path(workspace_id), &workspace)?;
            Ok(view)
        }
    
        pub fn abort_workspace(&self, workspace_id: &str) -> Result<()> {
            let _lock = self.lock_exclusive()?;
            let workspace = self.read_workspace(workspace_id)?;
            if workspace.committed_view.is_some() {
                bail!("workspace '{workspace_id}' is committed and cannot be aborted");
            }
            fs::remove_file(self.workspace_path(workspace_id))
                .with_context(|| format!("remove workspace '{workspace_id}'"))
        }
    
        pub fn snapshot(&self, name: &str, view_id: Option<&str>) -> Result<ViewManifest> {
            let _lock = self.lock_exclusive()?;
            validate_name(name, "snapshot")?;
            let view = match view_id {
                Some(view_id) => self.read_view(view_id)?,
                None => self
                    .current_view()
                    .transpose()?
                    .context("no current view")?,
            };
            let path = self.snapshot_path(name);
            if path.exists() {
                bail!("snapshot '{name}' already exists");
            }
            self.atomic_write(&path, format!("{}\n", view.view_id).as_bytes())?;
            Ok(view)
        }
    
        pub fn read_snapshot(&self, name: &str) -> Result<ViewManifest> {
            validate_name(name, "snapshot")?;
            let id = fs::read_to_string(self.snapshot_path(name))
                .with_context(|| format!("read snapshot '{name}'"))?;
            self.read_view(id.trim())
        }
    
        pub fn current_view_id(&self) -> Result<Option<String>> {
            let path = self.root.join("current");
            match fs::read_to_string(&path) {
                Ok(value) => Ok(Some(value.trim().to_string())),
                Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(None),
                Err(error) => Err(error).with_context(|| format!("read {}", path.display())),
            }
        }
    
        pub fn current_view(&self) -> Option<Result<ViewManifest>> {
            match self.current_view_id() {
                Ok(Some(id)) => Some(self.read_view(&id)),
                Ok(None) => None,
                Err(error) => Some(Err(error)),
            }
        }
    
        pub fn read_view(&self, id: &str) -> Result<ViewManifest> {
            validate_hash(id, "view")?;
            let view: ViewManifest = self.read_json(self.view_path(id))?;
            if view.view_id != id {
                bail!(
                    "view file identity mismatch: requested {id}, contains {}",
                    view.view_id
                );
            }
            let actual = hash_json(&ViewBody {
                format: view.format.clone(),
                source_catalog_hash: view.source_catalog_hash.clone(),
                source_catalog_generation: view.source_catalog_generation,
                parent_view: view.parent_view.clone(),
                objects: view.objects.clone(),
            })?;
            if actual != id {
                bail!("view {id} failed content-hash verification");
            }
            Ok(view)
        }
    
        pub fn read_object(&self, hash: &str) -> Result<TypedObjectBlob> {
            validate_hash(hash, "object")?;
            let path = self.object_path(hash);
            let bytes = fs::read(&path).with_context(|| format!("read {}", path.display()))?;
            if hash_bytes(&bytes) != hash {
                bail!("object {hash} failed content-hash verification");
            }
            let object: TypedObjectBlob =
                serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).with_context(|| format!("decode object {hash}"))?;
            object.validate(None)?;
            Ok(object)
        }
    
        pub fn object_for_view(&self, view: &ViewManifest, plugin_id: &str) -> Result<TypedObjectBlob> {
            let hash = view
                .objects
                .get(plugin_id)
                .with_context(|| format!("plugin '{plugin_id}' is not in view {}", view.view_id))?;
            self.read_object(hash)
        }
    
        pub fn workspace_object(
            &self,
            workspace: &Workspace,
            plugin_id: &str,
        ) -> Result<TypedObjectBlob> {
            if let Some(hash) = workspace.staged_objects.get(plugin_id) {
                return self.read_object(hash);
            }
            let view = self.read_view(&workspace.base_view)?;
            self.object_for_view(&view, plugin_id)
        }
    
        pub fn list_views(&self) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
            list_stems(&self.views_dir(), ".json")
        }
    
        pub fn list_workspaces(&self) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
            list_stems(&self.workspaces_dir(), ".json")
        }
    
        pub fn list_snapshots(&self) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
            list_stems(&self.snapshots_dir(), ".ref")
        }
    
        fn write_object(&self, object: &TypedObjectBlob) -> Result<String> {
            let bytes = canonical_json(object)?;
            let hash = hash_bytes(&bytes);
            let path = self.object_path(&hash);
            if !path.exists() {
                self.atomic_write(&path, &bytes)?;
            }
            Ok(hash)
        }
    
        fn write_view(&self, body: ViewBody) -> Result<ViewManifest> {
            let view_id = hash_json(&body)?;
            let view = ViewManifest {
                format: body.format,
                view_id: view_id.clone(),
                source_catalog_hash: body.source_catalog_hash,
                source_catalog_generation: body.source_catalog_generation,
                parent_view: body.parent_view,
                objects: body.objects,
            };
            let path = self.view_path(&view_id);
            if !path.exists() {
                self.atomic_json(&path, &view)?;
            }
            Ok(view)
        }
    
        fn set_current(&self, view_id: &str) -> Result<()> {
            self.read_view(view_id)?;
            self.atomic_write(
                &self.root.join("current"),
                format!("{view_id}\n").as_bytes(),
            )
        }
    
        fn atomic_json(&self, path: &Path, value: &impl Serialize) -> Result<()> {
            self.atomic_write(path, &canonical_json(value)?)
        }
    
        fn atomic_write(&self, path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {
            let parent = path.parent().context("atomic write path has no parent")?;
            fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
            let temp = parent.join(format!(
                ".{}.{}.tmp",
                path.file_name()
                    .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
                    .unwrap_or("object"),
                Uuid::new_v4()
            ));
            {
                let mut file = File::create(&temp)
                    .with_context(|| format!("create temporary file {}", temp.display()))?;
                file.write_all(bytes)?;
                file.sync_all()?;
            }
            fs::rename(&temp, path)
                .with_context(|| format!("publish {} -> {}", temp.display(), path.display()))?;
            File::open(parent)?.sync_all()?;
            Ok(())
        }
    
        fn read_json<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(&self, path: PathBuf) -> Result<T> {
            let bytes = fs::read(&path).with_context(|| format!("read {}", path.display()))?;
            serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).with_context(|| format!("decode {}", path.display()))
        }
    
        fn lock_exclusive(&self) -> Result<StoreLock> {
            let path = self.root.join(".lock");
            let file = OpenOptions::new()
                .create(true)
                .truncate(false)
                .read(true)
                .write(true)
                .open(&path)
                .with_context(|| format!("open store lock {}", path.display()))?;
            file.lock_exclusive()
                .with_context(|| format!("lock store {}", self.root.display()))?;
            Ok(StoreLock(file))
        }
    
        fn objects_dir(&self) -> PathBuf {
            self.root.join("objects")
        }
    
        fn views_dir(&self) -> PathBuf {
            self.root.join("views")
        }
    
        fn workspaces_dir(&self) -> PathBuf {
            self.root.join("workspaces")
        }
    
        fn snapshots_dir(&self) -> PathBuf {
            self.root.join("snapshots")
        }
    
        fn object_path(&self, hash: &str) -> PathBuf {
            self.objects_dir().join(format!("{hash}.blob"))
        }
    
        fn view_path(&self, id: &str) -> PathBuf {
            self.views_dir().join(format!("{id}.json"))
        }
    
        fn workspace_path(&self, id: &str) -> PathBuf {
            self.workspaces_dir().join(format!("{id}.json"))
        }
    
        fn snapshot_path(&self, name: &str) -> PathBuf {
            self.snapshots_dir().join(format!("{name}.ref"))
        }
    }
    
    struct StoreLock(File);
    
    impl Drop for StoreLock {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            let _ = self.0.unlock();
        }
    }
    
    fn canonical_json(value: &impl Serialize) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
        serde_json::to_vec(value).context("serialize canonical JSON")
    }
    
    fn hash_json(value: &impl Serialize) -> Result<String> {
        Ok(hash_bytes(&canonical_json(value)?))
    }
    
    fn hash_bytes(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
        blake3::hash(bytes).to_hex().to_string()
    }
    
    fn validate_hash(value: &str, kind: &str) -> Result<()> {
        if value.len() != 64 || !value.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
            bail!("invalid {kind} hash '{value}'");
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    fn validate_name(value: &str, kind: &str) -> Result<()> {
        if value.is_empty()
            || value.len() > 128
            || value == "."
            || value == ".."
            || !value
                .bytes()
                .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b"._-".contains(&byte))
        {
            bail!("invalid {kind} name '{value}'");
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    fn list_stems(directory: &Path, suffix: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
        let mut values = Vec::new();
        for entry in fs::read_dir(directory)
            .with_context(|| format!("list directory {}", directory.display()))?
        {
            let entry = entry?;
            if let Some(name) = entry.file_name().to_str()
                && let Some(stem) = name.strip_suffix(suffix)
            {
                values.push(stem.to_string());
            }
        }
        values.sort();
        Ok(values)
    }
    
    fn set_json_pointer(root: &mut Value, pointer: &str, value: Value) -> Result<()> {
        if pointer.is_empty() {
            *root = value;
            return Ok(());
        }
        if !pointer.starts_with('/') {
            bail!("JSON pointer must be empty or start with '/'");
        }
        let mut segments = pointer
            .split('/')
            .skip(1)
            .map(|segment| segment.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~"))
            .peekable();
        let mut current = root;
        while let Some(segment) = segments.next() {
            let is_last = segments.peek().is_none();
            match current {
                Value::Object(object) if is_last => {
                    object.insert(segment, value);
                    return Ok(());
                }
                Value::Object(object) => {
                    current = object.get_mut(&segment).with_context(|| {
                        format!("JSON pointer component '{segment}' does not exist")
                    })?;
                }
                Value::Array(array) => {
                    let index: usize = segment
                        .parse()
                        .with_context(|| format!("array pointer '{segment}' is not an index"))?;
                    let slot = array
                        .get_mut(index)
                        .with_context(|| format!("array pointer index {index} is out of bounds"))?;
                    if is_last {
                        *slot = value;
                        return Ok(());
                    }
                    current = slot;
                }
                _ => bail!("JSON pointer traverses a scalar at '{segment}'"),
            }
        }
        bail!("invalid JSON pointer '{pointer}'")
    }

        pub fn capture(&self) -> Result<SourceSnapshot> {
            for _ in 0..4 {
                let catalog_before = self.read_catalog_manifest()?;
                let state_before = self.read_state_generation()?;
                let mut objects = BTreeMap::new();

                    let value = self.read_state(plugin_id, &schema);

                            .with_context(|| format!("validate typed source object '{plugin_id}'"))?;
                    objects.insert(plugin_id.clone(), object);
                }
    
                let catalog_after = self.read_catalog_manifest()?;
                let state_after = self.read_state_generation()?;
                if catalog_before == catalog_after && state_before == state_after {
                    return Ok(SourceSnapshot {
                        catalog_hash: catalog_after.catalog_hash,
                        catalog_generation: catalog_after.generation,
                        objects,
                    });
                }
            }
    
            bail!("SHM source changed during four capture attempts")
        }

                Ok(bytes) => match serde_json::from_slice::<serde_json::Value>(&bytes) {
                    Ok(value) => match schema.validate_value(&value, None) {
                        Ok(()) => value,
                        Err(e) => {
                            if std::env::var("THREETCHEDFS_DEBUG").is_ok() {
                                eprintln!("3tchedfs: state fallback for {plugin_id}: {e}");
                            }
                            schema.template()

                    Err(e) => {
                        if std::env::var("THREETCHEDFS_DEBUG").is_ok() {
                            eprintln!("3tchedfs: state parse error for {plugin_id}: {e}");
                        }
                        schema.template()
                    }

                Err(e) => {
                    if std::env::var("THREETCHEDFS_DEBUG").is_ok() {
                        eprintln!("3tchedfs: state read error for {plugin_id}: {e}");
                    }
                    schema.template()
                }
            }
        }
    
        fn read_schema(&self, plugin_id: &str, expected_hash: &str) -> Result<PluginSchema> {
            if plugin_id.is_empty()
                || plugin_id.len() > 128
                || !plugin_id
                    .bytes()
                    .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_lowercase() || byte.is_ascii_digit() || byte == b'_')
            {
                bail!("invalid canonical plugin id '{plugin_id}'");
            }
            if expected_hash.len() != 64
                || !expected_hash
                    .bytes()
                    .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit() || (b'a'..=b'f').contains(&byte))
            {
                bail!("invalid schema hash for '{plugin_id}'");
            }
            let file = self
                .catalog_dir
                .join(format!("{plugin_id}.{}.blob", &expected_hash[..16]));
            let bytes =
                fs::read(&file).with_context(|| format!("read source blob {}", file.display()))?;
            let blob = OpBlobRef::new(&bytes)
                .with_context(|| format!("decode source blob {}", file.display()))?;
            let actual_hash = blob.schema_hash_hex();
            if actual_hash != expected_hash {
                bail!(
                    "manifest hash mismatch for '{plugin_id}': expected {expected_hash}, got {actual_hash}"
                );
            }
            // The schema's own authority decodes it, so this projection reads
            // exactly what was sealed; `from_sealed` then fails to compile, not to
            // capture, whenever the authority's shape changes.
            let sealed: op_state_store::PluginSchema = serde_json::from_slice(blob.schema_json())
                .with_context(|| format!("decode sealed PluginSchema for '{plugin_id}'"))?;
            crate::model::from_sealed(sealed)
                .with_context(|| format!("convert sealed PluginSchema for '{plugin_id}'"))
        }

    struct OpBlobRef<'a> {
        bytes: &'a [u8],
        schema_range: std::ops::Range<usize>,
    }
    
    impl<'a> OpBlobRef<'a> {
        fn new(bytes: &'a [u8]) -> Result<Self> {
            if bytes.len() < HEADER_LEN || &bytes[..8] != MAGIC {
                bail!("not an OPBLOB01 blob");
            }
            let version = u16::from_le_bytes([bytes[8], bytes[9]]);
            if version != 1 {
                bail!("unsupported OPBLOB format version {version}");
            }
            let count = u16::from_le_bytes([bytes[10], bytes[11]]) as usize;
            let table_end = HEADER_LEN
                .checked_add(
                    count
                        .checked_mul(SECTION_ENTRY_LEN)
                        .context("section count overflow")?,
                )
                .context("section table overflow")?;
            if table_end > bytes.len() {
                bail!("section table overruns blob");
            }
    
            let mut schema_range = None;
            for index in 0..count {
                let entry = HEADER_LEN + index * SECTION_ENTRY_LEN;
                let tag = u32::from_le_bytes(bytes[entry..entry + 4].try_into()?);
                let offset = u64::from_le_bytes(bytes[entry + 8..entry + 16].try_into()?) as usize;
                let length = u64::from_le_bytes(bytes[entry + 16..entry + 24].try_into()?) as usize;
                let end = offset
                    .checked_add(length)
                    .context("section range overflow")?;
                if end > bytes.len() {
                    bail!("section {tag} overruns blob");
                }
                if tag == SECTION_SCHEMA_JSON && schema_range.replace(offset..end).is_some() {
                    bail!("duplicate schema section");
                }
            }
    
            let schema_range = schema_range.context("missing schema section")?;
            let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
            hasher.update(&bytes[schema_range.clone()]);
            if hasher.finalize().as_slice() != &bytes[16..48] {
                bail!("schema hash mismatch: blob is corrupt or tampered");
            }
    
            Ok(Self {
                bytes,
                schema_range,
            })
        }
    
        fn schema_json(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
            &self.bytes[self.schema_range.clone()]
        }
    
        fn schema_hash_hex(&self) -> String {
            self.bytes[16..48]
                .iter()
                .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
                .collect()
        }
    }
    
    fn read_json<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Result<T> {
        let path = path.as_ref();
        let bytes = fs::read(path).with_context(|| format!("read {}", path.display()))?;
        serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).with_context(|| format!("decode {}", path.display()))
    }

    struct LockedDirectory {
        directory: File,
        _lock: Flock<File>,
    }
    
    fn open_at(directory: &File, name: &std::ffi::OsStr, flags: OFlag, mode: u32) -> nix::Result<File> {
        let raw = nix::fcntl::openat(
            Some(directory.as_raw_fd()),
            name,
            flags | OFlag::O_NOFOLLOW | OFlag::O_CLOEXEC,
            Mode::from_bits_truncate(mode),
        )?;
        // SAFETY: nix 0.28 returns a newly owned descriptor on success. Ownership
        // transfers exactly once to File, which closes it on every exit path.
        Ok(unsafe { File::from_raw_fd(raw) })
    }
    
    fn directory(path: &Path, create: bool, mode: u32) -> Result<Option<File>> {
        ensure!(
            path.is_absolute() && path != Path::new("/"),
            "projection directory must be absolute and not the filesystem root"
        );
        ensure!(
            !path
                .to_string_lossy()
                .split('/')
                .any(|part| part == "." || part == ".."),
            "projection directory must not contain dot components"
        );
        let mut current = File::open("/")?;
        for component in path.components() {
            match component {
                Component::RootDir => {}
                Component::Normal(name) => {
                    let opened = open_at(&current, name, OFlag::O_RDONLY | OFlag::O_DIRECTORY, 0);
                    current = match opened {
                        Ok(file) => file,
                        Err(Errno::ENOENT) if create => {
                            match nix::sys::stat::mkdirat(
                                Some(current.as_raw_fd()),
                                name,
                                Mode::from_bits_truncate(mode),
                            ) {
                                Ok(()) | Err(Errno::EEXIST) => {}
                                Err(error) => return Err(error.into()),
                            }
                            open_at(&current, name, OFlag::O_RDONLY | OFlag::O_DIRECTORY, 0)?
                        }
                        Err(Errno::ENOENT) => return Ok(None),
                        Err(error) => {
                            return Err(error)
                                .context("projection directory must have no symlink components");
                        }
                    };
                }
                _ => bail!("projection directory must not contain dot components"),
            }
        }
        let metadata = current.metadata()?;
        ensure!(
            trusted_directory_owner(metadata.uid(), nix::unistd::geteuid().as_raw(), create),
            "projection directory must be owned by the writing service user or trusted root reader source"
        );
        ensure!(
            metadata.mode() & 0o022 == 0,
            "projection directory must not be writable by other users or groups"
        );
        Ok(Some(current))
    }

                &filename(plugin)?,
                MAX_PROJECTION.min(remaining),
                false,
            )? {
                remaining = remaining
                    .checked_sub(bytes.len() as u64)
                    .context("projection snapshot exceeds aggregate byte budget")?;
                states.insert(plugin.clone(), bytes);
            }
        }
        Ok(ProjectionSnapshot {
            generation: manifest.generation,
            states,
        })
    }

        /// tells the writer which stage failed; the `error` file says why.
        fn lungs_call(
            &mut self,
            plugin_id: &str,
            method: &str,
            bytes: &[u8],
        ) -> Result<Vec<u8>, (i32, Vec<u8>)> {
            let outcome = self.run_lungs_call(plugin_id, method, bytes);
            let entry = self
                .outcomes
                .entry((plugin_id.to_string(), method.to_string()))
                .or_default();
            match outcome {
                Ok(receipt) => {
                    entry.result = pretty(&receipt);
                    entry.error.clear();
                    Ok(entry.result.clone())
                }
                Err(error) => {
                    entry.result.clear();
                    entry.error = pretty(&serde_json::json!({
                        "plugin": plugin_id,
                        "method": method,
                        "stage": error.stage(),
                        "error": error.to_string(),
                    }));
                    Err((error.errno(), entry.error.clone()))
                }
            }
        }
    
        fn run_lungs_call(
            &self,
            plugin_id: &str,
            method_name: &str,
            bytes: &[u8],
        ) -> Result<CallReceipt, LungsError> {
            let lungs = self
                .lungs
                .as_ref()
                .ok_or_else(|| LungsError::Transport("not a lungs mount".into()))?;
            let arguments: Value =
                serde_json::from_slice(bytes).map_err(|error| LungsError::Json(error.to_string()))?;
            let method =
                dispatch::method_decl(&self.store, &self.namespace.target, plugin_id, method_name)
                    .map_err(|error| LungsError::Arguments(error.to_string()))?;
            dispatch::validate_arguments(&method, &arguments)?;
            let credential = match lungs {
                Lungs::Socket { .. } => None,
                Lungs::Credential { credential, .. } => Some(dispatch::read_credential(credential)?),
            };
            // FUSE callbacks run inside the mount's tokio context, which cannot
            // block on another future. A scoped thread with its own runtime keeps
            // the D-Bus round trip off that context.
            std::thread::scope(|scope| {
                scope
                    .spawn(move || {
                        let runtime = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread()
                            .enable_all()
                            .build()
                            .map_err(|error| LungsError::Transport(format!("runtime: {error}")))?;
                        runtime.block_on(async {
                            match (lungs, credential) {
                                (Lungs::Credential { bus_address, .. }, Some(credential)) => {
                                    dispatch::call_as_identity(
                                        bus_address,
                                        plugin_id,
                                        method_name,
                                        &method,
                                        arguments,
                                        credential,
                                    )
                                    .await
                                }
                                (Lungs::Socket { path, session }, _) => {
                                    dispatch::call_over_socket(
                                        path,
                                        session,
                                        plugin_id,
                                        method_name,
                                        &method,
                                        arguments,
                                    )
                                    .await
                                }
                                (Lungs::Credential { .. }, None) => {
                                    Err(LungsError::Credential("credential was not read".into()))
                                }
                            }
                        })
                    })
                    .join()
                    .unwrap_or_else(|_| Err(LungsError::Transport("dispatch thread panicked".into())))
            })
        }
    
        fn attr(&self, node: &Node, size_override: Option<u64>) -> FileAttr {
            let (kind, size, perm, nlink) = match &node.kind {
                NodeKind::Directory => (FileType::Directory, 0, 0o555, 2),
                NodeKind::File(bytes) => (
                    FileType::RegularFile,
                    size_override.unwrap_or_else(|| bytes.read().len() as u64),
                    if node.write_target.is_some() {
                        0o644
                    } else {
                        0o444
                    },
                    1,
                ),
                NodeKind::LiveFile { .. } => {
                    let size = size_override.unwrap_or_else(|| {
                        self.live_state_bytes(node)
                            .map(|b| b.len() as u64)
                            .unwrap_or(0)
                    });
                    (FileType::RegularFile, size, 0o444, 1)
                }
                NodeKind::Symlink(target) => (FileType::Symlink, target.len() as u64, 0o777, 1),
                // Receipts are readable only through the handle that ran the call.
                NodeKind::CallFile { .. } => {
                    (FileType::RegularFile, size_override.unwrap_or(0), 0o666, 1)
                }
                NodeKind::Outcome {
                    plugin_id,
                    method,
                    error,
                } => {
                    let size = size_override
                        .unwrap_or_else(|| self.outcome_bytes(plugin_id, method, *error).len() as u64);
                    (FileType::RegularFile, size, 0o444, 1)
                }
            };
            FileAttr {
                ino: node.ino,
                size,
                blocks: size.div_ceil(512),
                atime: UNIX_EPOCH,
                mtime: UNIX_EPOCH,
                ctime: UNIX_EPOCH,
                crtime: UNIX_EPOCH,
                kind,
                perm,
                nlink,
                uid: self.uid,
                gid: self.gid,
                rdev: 0,
                flags: 0,
                blksize: 4096,
            }
        }
    
        /// Read a plugin's live state from SHM and extract the value at the given
        /// JSON pointer, as pretty-printed JSON bytes. Rendering happens once per
        /// committed state version; later opens and size checks reuse it.
        fn live_state_bytes(&self, node: &Node) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
            let (plugin_id, pointer) = match &node.kind {
                NodeKind::LiveFile { plugin_id, pointer } => (plugin_id.as_str(), pointer.as_str()),
                _ => return None,
            };
            let state_dir = self.namespace.state_dir.as_ref()?;
            let path = state_dir.join(format!("{plugin_id}.json"));
            let key = StateKey::of(&std::fs::metadata(&path).ok()?);
            let cache_key = (plugin_id.to_string(), pointer.to_string());
            if let Some((cached, bytes)) = self.live_cache.lock().get(&cache_key)
                && *cached == key
            {
                return Some(bytes.clone());
            }
            let raw = std::fs::read(&path).ok()?;
            let value: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&raw).ok()?;
            let extracted = if pointer.is_empty() {
                value
            } else {
                value.pointer(pointer).cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null)
            };
            let mut bytes = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&extracted).ok()?;
            bytes.push(b'\n');
            // A commit that lands between the stat and the read is stored under
            // the older key, so the next open simply renders it again.
            self.live_cache
                .lock()
                .insert(cache_key, (key, bytes.clone()));
            Some(bytes)
        }
    
        fn refresh_namespace(&mut self) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
            let state_dir = self.namespace.state_dir.clone();
            self.namespace = Namespace::build_with(
                &self.store,
                self.namespace.target.clone(),
                state_dir.as_deref(),
                self.namespace.lungs,
            )?;
            if let Some(Lungs::Socket { session, .. }) = &self.lungs
                && !session.is_empty()
            {
                self.namespace.declare_socket_session(session)?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    
        fn flush_handle(&mut self, fh: u64) -> Result<(), i32> {
            let Some(handle) = self.open_files.get_mut(&fh) else {
                return Err(ENOENT);
            };
            if let Some(completed) = &handle.completed {
                return completed.as_ref().map(|_| ()).map_err(|(errno, _)| *errno);
            }
            if !handle.dirty {
                return Ok(());
            }
            let node = self.namespace.node(handle.ino).ok_or(ENOENT)?;
            if let NodeKind::CallFile { plugin_id, method } = &node.kind {
                // Clear dirty first: release flushes again, and a call must run
                // once per complete write even when it fails.
                handle.dirty = false;
                if handle.bytes.is_empty() {
                    return Ok(());
                }
                let bytes = std::mem::take(&mut handle.bytes);
                let (plugin_id, method) = (plugin_id.clone(), method.clone());
                let completed = self.lungs_call(&plugin_id, &method, &bytes);
                let result = completed.as_ref().map(|_| ()).map_err(|(errno, _)| *errno);
                self.open_files.get_mut(&fh).ok_or(ENOENT)?.completed = Some(completed);
                return result;
            }
            let target = node.write_target.clone().ok_or(EROFS)?;
            let value: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&handle.bytes).map_err(|_| EINVAL)?;
            self.store
                .stage_pointer(
                    &target.workspace_id,
                    &target.plugin_id,
                    &target.pointer,
                    value,
                )
                .map_err(|_| EINVAL)?;
            handle.dirty = false;
            self.refresh_namespace().map_err(|_| EIO)?;
            Ok(())
        }
    
        fn read_bytes(&self, ino: u64, fh: u64) -> Result<Vec<u8>, i32> {
            if let Some(handle) = self.open_files.get(&fh)
                && handle.ino == ino
            {
                if matches!(
                    self.namespace.node(ino).ok_or(ENOENT)?.kind,
                    NodeKind::CallFile { .. }
                ) {
                    return Ok(match &handle.completed {
                        Some(Ok(receipt)) => receipt.clone(),
                        Some(Err((_, diagnostic))) => diagnostic.clone(),
                        None => Vec::new(),
                    });
                }
                return Ok(handle.bytes.clone());
            }
            match &self.namespace.node(ino).ok_or(ENOENT)?.kind {
                NodeKind::File(bytes) => Ok(bytes.read().clone()),
                NodeKind::LiveFile { .. } => {
                    let node = self.namespace.node(ino).ok_or(ENOENT)?;
                    self.live_state_bytes(node).ok_or(EIO)
                }
                NodeKind::Directory => Err(EISDIR),
                NodeKind::Symlink(_) => Err(EINVAL),
                NodeKind::CallFile { .. } => Ok(Vec::new()),
                NodeKind::Outcome {
                    plugin_id,
                    method,
                    error,
                } => Ok(self.outcome_bytes(plugin_id, method, *error)),
            }
        }
    }
    
    fn pretty(value: &impl serde::Serialize) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut bytes = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(value).unwrap_or_default();
        bytes.push(b'\n');
        bytes
    }
    
    use std::path::Path;
    
    use anyhow::{Context, Result, bail};
    use serde::Serialize;
    use serde_json::Value;
    use zbus::Proxy;
    
    use crate::model::{MethodDecl, SideEffect};
    use crate::namespace::ProjectionTarget;
    use crate::store::ObjectStore;
    
    pub const DEFAULT_BUS_ADDRESS: &str = "unix:path=/run/opdbus/session-bus.sock";
    
    const PLUGIN_BUS_NAME: &str = "org.opdbus.v1.plugins";
    const PLUGIN_INTERFACE: &str = "org.opdbus.v1.PluginV1";
    /// The bridge's D-Bus identity bootstrap. A sender that registers a SID1
    /// here is admitted as that identity for every later call on the same
    /// connection, subject to the identity's own grants.
    const IDENTITY_OBJECT_PATH: &str = "/org/opdbus/v1/identity/dbus";
    const IDENTITY_INTERFACE: &str = "org.opdbus.v1.DbusIdentityV1";
    /// Mirrors the bridge's registration bound; larger files are not SID1.
    const MAX_CREDENTIAL_BYTES: u64 = 16 * 1024;
    /// The bridge's lungs bootstrap: a connection binds to one session here first.
    const LUNGS_OBJECT_PATH: &str = "/org/opdbus/v1/lungs";
    const LUNGS_INTERFACE: &str = "org.opdbus.v1.LungsV1";
    const LUNGS_NEGOTIATION_TIMEOUT: std::time::Duration = std::time::Duration::from_secs(10);
    
    #[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
    pub struct CallReceipt {
        pub plugin_id: String,
        pub method: String,
        pub subid: String,
        pub required_capability: Option<String>,
        pub side_effect: SideEffect,
        pub idempotent: bool,
        pub result: Value,
    }
    
    /// Why a lungs call did not complete. Each stage maps to one errno so the
    /// writer learns what failed from `close()`, and the full text goes to the
    /// method's `error` file.
    #[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
    pub enum LungsError {
        #[error("arguments are not a JSON value: {0}")]
        Json(String),
        #[error("arguments failed schema validation: {0}")]
        Arguments(String),
        #[error("no credential has been delivered to this identity: {0}")]
        Credential(String),
        #[error("identity registration refused: {0}")]
        Registration(String),
        #[error("call refused: {0}")]
        Refused(String),
        #[error("dispatch failed: {0}")]
        Transport(String),
    }
    
    impl LungsError {
        pub fn stage(&self) -> &'static str {
            match self {
                Self::Json(_) => "parse",
                Self::Arguments(_) => "validate",
                Self::Credential(_) => "credential",
                Self::Registration(_) => "register",
                Self::Refused(_) => "call",
                Self::Transport(_) => "transport",
            }
        }
    
        pub fn errno(&self) -> i32 {
            match self {
                Self::Json(_) | Self::Arguments(_) => libc::EINVAL,
                Self::Credential(_) | Self::Registration(_) | Self::Refused(_) => libc::EACCES,
                Self::Transport(_) => libc::EIO,
            }
        }
    }
    
    pub fn method_decl(
        store: &ObjectStore,
        target: &ProjectionTarget,
        plugin_id: &str,
        method_name: &str,
    ) -> Result<MethodDecl> {
        let object = match target {
            ProjectionTarget::View(id) => {
                let view = store.read_view(id)?;
                store.object_for_view(&view, plugin_id)?
            }
            ProjectionTarget::Workspace(id) => {
                let workspace = store.read_workspace(id)?;
                store.workspace_object(&workspace, plugin_id)?
            }
        };
        object
            .schema
            .methods
            .get(method_name)
            .cloned()
            .with_context(|| format!("method '{plugin_id}.{method_name}' is not schema-declared"))
    }
    
    pub fn validate_arguments(method: &MethodDecl, arguments: &Value) -> Result<(), LungsError> {
        jsonschema::Validator::new(&method.args)
            .map_err(|error| LungsError::Arguments(format!("sealed argument schema: {error}")))?
            .validate(arguments)
            .map_err(|error| LungsError::Arguments(error.to_string()))
    }
    
    /// Read the identity's SID1 from its own device. It is read per call, so a
    /// delivered or refreshed credential takes effect without a remount.
    pub fn read_credential(path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<u8>, LungsError> {
        let metadata = std::fs::metadata(path)
            .map_err(|error| LungsError::Credential(format!("{}: {error}", path.display())))?;
        if !metadata.is_file() || metadata.len() == 0 || metadata.len() > MAX_CREDENTIAL_BYTES {
            return Err(LungsError::Credential(format!(
                "{} is not a SID1 credential file",
                path.display()
            )));
        }
        let bytes = std::fs::read(path)
            .map_err(|error| LungsError::Credential(format!("{}: {error}", path.display())))?;
        if !bytes.starts_with(b"SID1") {
            return Err(LungsError::Credential(format!(
                "{} does not hold a SID1 envelope",
                path.display()
            )));
        }
        Ok(bytes)
    }
    
    pub async fn call(
        store: &ObjectStore,
        target: &ProjectionTarget,
        bus_address: &str,
        plugin_id: &str,
        method_name: &str,
        arguments: Value,
        confirm_side_effects: bool,
    ) -> Result<CallReceipt> {
        let method = method_decl(store, target, plugin_id, method_name)?;
        validate_arguments(&method, &arguments)?;
    
        if method.side_effect != SideEffect::Read && !confirm_side_effects {
            bail!(
                "'{plugin_id}.{method_name}' is a {:?} operation; pass --confirm-side-effects",
                method.side_effect
            );
        }
    
        let connection = zbus::connection::Builder::address(bus_address)?
            .build()
            .await
            .with_context(|| format!("connect to D-Bus at {bus_address}"))?;
        let result = plugin_call(&connection, plugin_id, method_name, &arguments)
            .await
            .map_err(|error| anyhow::anyhow!("dispatch '{plugin_id}.{method_name}': {error}"))?;
        Ok(receipt(plugin_id, method_name, &method, result))
    }
    
    /// Dispatch as the identity that owns the lungs mount. Registration and the
    /// call share one connection, so the bridge admits the call as that identity
    /// and runs it through MutationEngine under the identity's own grants.
    pub async fn call_as_identity(
        bus_address: &str,
        plugin_id: &str,
        method_name: &str,
        method: &MethodDecl,
        arguments: Value,
        credential: Vec<u8>,
    ) -> Result<CallReceipt, LungsError> {
        let connection = zbus::connection::Builder::address(bus_address)
            .map_err(|error| LungsError::Transport(format!("bus address {bus_address}: {error}")))?
            .build()
            .await
            .map_err(|error| LungsError::Transport(format!("connect to {bus_address}: {error}")))?;
        let bootstrap = Proxy::new(
            &connection,
            PLUGIN_BUS_NAME,
            IDENTITY_OBJECT_PATH,
            IDENTITY_INTERFACE,
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|error| LungsError::Transport(format!("identity bootstrap proxy: {error}")))?;
        let registered: bool = bootstrap
            .call("RegisterCurrentSender", &(credential,))
            .await
            .map_err(|error| match refusal(&error) {
                true => LungsError::Registration(error.to_string()),
                false => LungsError::Transport(format!("register: {error}")),
            })?;
        if !registered {
            return Err(LungsError::Registration(
                "bridge declined the credential".into(),
            ));
        }
        let result = plugin_call(&connection, plugin_id, method_name, &arguments)
            .await
            .map_err(|error| match refusal(&error) {
                true => LungsError::Refused(error.to_string()),
                false => LungsError::Transport(format!("call: {error}")),
            })?;
        Ok(receipt(plugin_id, method_name, method, result))
    }
    
    /// Dispatch over the bridge's shared lungs socket. The connection first binds
    /// to this identity's session, so no credential crosses it. An empty session
    /// calls the no-argument container bootstrap; the bridge derives identity
    /// from its kernel peer and native Incus binding. A named session uses the
    /// host-root-only bootstrap. Both run through the identity's own grants.
    pub async fn call_over_socket(
        socket: &Path,
        session: &str,
        plugin_id: &str,
        method_name: &str,
        method: &MethodDecl,
        arguments: Value,
    ) -> Result<CallReceipt, LungsError> {
        let stream = tokio::net::UnixStream::connect(socket)
            .await
            .map_err(|error| {
                LungsError::Transport(format!("connect to {}: {error}", socket.display()))
            })?;
        let connection = tokio::time::timeout(
            LUNGS_NEGOTIATION_TIMEOUT,
            zbus::connection::Builder::unix_stream(stream)
                .p2p()
                .auth_mechanism(zbus::connection::AuthMechanism::Anonymous)
                .build(),
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|_| LungsError::Transport("lungs socket negotiation timed out".into()))?
        .map_err(|error| LungsError::Transport(format!("lungs socket: {error}")))?;
        let lungs = Proxy::new(
            &connection,
            PLUGIN_BUS_NAME,
            LUNGS_OBJECT_PATH,
            LUNGS_INTERFACE,
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|error| LungsError::Transport(format!("lungs bind proxy: {error}")))?;
        let binding = if session.is_empty() {
            lungs.call("BindCurrentContainer", &()).await
        } else {
            lungs.call("Bind", &(session,)).await
        };
        let bound: bool = binding.map_err(|error| match refusal(&error) {
            true => LungsError::Registration(error.to_string()),
            false => LungsError::Transport(format!("bind: {error}")),
        })?;
        if !bound {
            return Err(LungsError::Registration(
                "bridge declined to bind this session".into(),
            ));
        }
        let result = plugin_call(&connection, plugin_id, method_name, &arguments)
            .await
            .map_err(|error| match refusal(&error) {
                true => LungsError::Refused(error.to_string()),
                false => LungsError::Transport(format!("call: {error}")),
            })?;
        Ok(receipt(plugin_id, method_name, method, result))
    }
    
    async fn plugin_call(
        connection: &zbus::Connection,
        plugin_id: &str,
        method_name: &str,
        arguments: &Value,
    ) -> zbus::Result<Value> {
        let proxy = Proxy::new(
            connection,
            PLUGIN_BUS_NAME,
            format!("/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/{plugin_id}"),
            PLUGIN_INTERFACE,
        )
        .await?;
        let json_args = serde_json::to_string(arguments)
            .map_err(|error| zbus::Error::Failure(format!("serialize arguments: {error}")))?;
        let response: String = proxy
            .call("Call", &(method_name.to_string(), json_args))
            .await?;
        Ok(serde_json::from_str(&response).unwrap_or(Value::String(response)))
    }
    
    fn refusal(error: &zbus::Error) -> bool {
        matches!(error, zbus::Error::MethodError(name, _, _)
            if name.as_str() == "org.freedesktop.DBus.Error.AccessDenied")
            || matches!(error, zbus::Error::FDO(fdo) if matches!(**fdo, zbus::fdo::Error::AccessDenied(_)))
    }
    
    fn receipt(plugin_id: &str, method_name: &str, method: &MethodDecl, result: Value) -> CallReceipt {
        CallReceipt {
            plugin_id: plugin_id.to_string(),
            method: method_name.to_string(),
            subid: method.subid.clone(),
            required_capability: method.required_capability.clone(),
            side_effect: method.side_effect,
            idempotent: method.idempotent,
            result,
        }
    }

            );
            ensure!(
                read_json(open_relative(
                    &self.root,
                    &format!("{prefix}/input.schema.json"),
                    false
                )?)? == decl.args,
                "mounted operation argument schema changed"
            );
            let file = open_relative(&self.root, &format!("{prefix}/call"), true)?;
            self.verify()?;

            // never justification for automatically submitting the call again.
            self.verify()
                .context("mount changed during operation; do not retry automatically")?;

    }
    
    fn terminal_receipt(
        body: &str,
        synced: std::io::Result<()>,
        plugin: &str,
        method: &str,
        decl: &MethodDecl,
    ) -> Result<Value> {
        let value: Value =
            serde_json::from_str(body).context("missing or malformed terminal operation receipt")?;
        if value.get("error").is_some() {
            ensure!(
                value["plugin"] == plugin && value["method"] == method,
                "operation diagnostic attribution mismatch"
            );
            return Err(MountedDiagnostic(value).into());
        }
        ensure!(
            value["plugin_id"] == plugin && value["method"] == method,
            "operation receipt attribution mismatch"
        );
        synced.context("operation fsync failed without a terminal diagnostic")?;
        ensure!(
            value["subid"] == decl.subid
                && value["required_capability"] == serde_json::to_value(&decl.required_capability)?
                && value["side_effect"] == serde_json::to_value(decl.side_effect)?
                && value["idempotent"] == decl.idempotent,
            "operation receipt contract mismatch"
        );
        ensure!(

    fn read_bounded(reader: impl Read, limit: u64) -> Result<String> {
        let mut bytes = Vec::new();
        reader.take(limit + 1).read_to_end(&mut bytes)?;
        ensure!(
            bytes.len() as u64 <= limit,
            "mounted document exceeds {limit} byte limit"
        );
        String::from_utf8(bytes).context("mounted document is not UTF-8")
    }

    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
    pub struct TypedObjectBlob {
        pub format: String,
        pub plugin_id: String,
        pub source_schema_hash: String,
        pub schema: PluginSchema,
        pub value: Value,
    }
    
    impl TypedObjectBlob {
        pub fn new(
            plugin_id: String,
            source_schema_hash: String,
            schema: PluginSchema,
            value: Value,
        ) -> Result<Self> {
            let blob = Self {
                format: FORMAT_VERSION.to_string(),
                plugin_id,
                source_schema_hash,
                schema,
                value,
            };
            blob.validate(None)?;
            Ok(blob)
        }
    
        pub fn validate(&self, base: Option<&Value>) -> Result<()> {
            if self.format != FORMAT_VERSION {
                bail!("unsupported typed object format '{}'", self.format);
            }
            if self.schema.name != self.plugin_id {
                bail!(
                    "schema name '{}' does not match plugin id '{}'",
                    self.schema.name,
                    self.plugin_id
                );
            }
            self.schema.validate_value(&self.value, base)
        }
    }

        pub capability_grants: BTreeMap<String, Vec<String>>,
        /// Which state fields a public projection may expose.
        #[serde(default)]
        pub public_state: Value,
        /// Field write routes, keyed by field.
        #[serde(default)]
        pub field_writes: BTreeMap<String, Value>,

        #[serde(default)]
        pub example: Option<Value>,
    }
    
    impl PluginSchema {
        pub fn validate_value(&self, root: &Value, base: Option<&Value>) -> Result<()> {
            let object = root
                .as_object()
                .with_context(|| format!("{} state must be an object", self.name))?;
    
            for (name, field) in &self.fields {
                match object.get(name) {
                    Some(value) => field
                        .validate(value, root)
                        .with_context(|| format!("field /{name}"))?,
                    None if field.required => bail!("required field /{name} is missing"),
                    None => {}
                }
            }
    
            if let Some(base) = base {
                let base_object = base
                    .as_object()
                    .with_context(|| format!("base {} state must be an object", self.name))?;
                validate_object_immutability(&self.fields, object, base_object, "")?;
    
                for pointer in &self.immutable_paths {
                    if root.pointer(pointer) != base.pointer(pointer) {
                        bail!("immutable path {pointer} changed");
                    }
                }
    
                if self.tags.iter().any(|tag| tag == "immutable") && root != base {
                    bail!("plugin {} is immutable", self.name);
                }
            }
    
            Ok(())
        }
    
        pub fn template(&self) -> Value {
            let values = self
                .fields
                .iter()
                .map(|(name, schema)| (name.clone(), schema.template()))
                .collect();
            Value::Object(values)
        }
    
        /// The capabilities that at least one method requires.
        pub fn required_capabilities(&self) -> BTreeSet<&str> {
            self.methods
                .values()
                .filter_map(|method| method.required_capability.as_deref())
                .collect()
        }
    }

        /// A live view for one identity, with a lungs `call` file per method.
        pub fn build_lungs(

            if !matches!(target, ProjectionTarget::View(_)) {
                bail!("a lungs mount projects a pinned view, not a workspace");
            }

        pub fn build_with(
            store: &ObjectStore,
            target: ProjectionTarget,
            state_dir: Option<&std::path::Path>,
            lungs: bool,
        ) -> Result<Self> {

                ProjectionTarget::View(id) => (store.read_view(id)?, None),
                ProjectionTarget::Workspace(id) => {
                    let workspace = store.read_workspace(id)?;
                    let view = store.read_view(&workspace.base_view)?;
                    (view, Some(workspace))
                }
            };
            // View mounts read live state from SHM; workspace mounts use frozen COW.
            let live = workspace.is_none() && state_dir.is_some();
            let mut builder =

            builder.add_root_metadata(&view, workspace.as_ref())?;
    
            let plugins = builder.add_dir(ROOT_INO, "plugins")?;
            let operations = builder.add_dir(ROOT_INO, "operations")?;
            let relationships = builder.add_dir(ROOT_INO, "relationships")?;
            let dependencies = builder.add_dir(relationships, "dependencies")?;
            let capabilities = builder.add_dir(ROOT_INO, "capabilities")?;
    
            for plugin_id in view.objects.keys() {
                let object = match &workspace {
                    Some(workspace) => store.workspace_object(workspace, plugin_id)?,
                    None => store.object_for_view(&view, plugin_id)?,
                };
                let plugin_name = encode_component(plugin_id);
                let plugin_dir = builder.add_dir(plugins, &plugin_name)?;
                builder.add_json(plugin_dir, "object.blob.json", &object, None)?;
                builder.add_json(plugin_dir, "schema.json", &object.schema, None)?;
                if live {
                    builder.add_live_file(plugin_dir, "value.json", plugin_id, "")?;
                } else {
                    builder.add_json(plugin_dir, "value.json", &object.value, None)?;
                }
                builder.add_json(
                    plugin_dir,
                    "capabilities.json",
                    &object.schema.required_capabilities(),
                    None,
                )?;
                builder.add_text(
                    plugin_dir,
                    "object.hash",
                    format!(
                        "{}\n",
                        object_hash_for_target(&view, workspace.as_ref(), plugin_id)?
                    )
                    .into_bytes(),
                    None,
                )?;
    
                let data_dir = builder.add_dir(plugin_dir, "data")?;
                let workspace_id = workspace
                    .as_ref()
                    .map(|workspace| workspace.workspace_id.clone());
                builder.add_value_children(
                    data_dir,
                    plugin_id,
                    "",
                    &object.value,
                    Some(&object.schema),
                    None,
                    workspace_id.as_deref(),
                    !object.schema.tags.iter().any(|tag| tag == "immutable"),
                    live,
                )?;
    
                let methods_dir = builder.add_dir(plugin_dir, "operations")?;
                let root_methods_dir = builder.add_dir(operations, &plugin_name)?;
                for (method_name, method) in &object.schema.methods {
                    let encoded = encode_component(method_name);
                    let method_dir = builder.add_dir(methods_dir, &encoded)?;
                    builder.add_json(method_dir, "input.schema.json", &method.args, None)?;
                    if let Some(returns) = &method.returns {
                        builder.add_json(method_dir, "output.schema.json", returns, None)?;
                    }
                    builder.add_json(method_dir, "metadata.json", method, None)?;
                    if lungs {
                        builder.add_lungs_files(method_dir, plugin_id, method_name)?;
                    }
                    builder.add_symlink(
                        root_methods_dir,
                        &encoded,
                        format!("/plugins/{plugin_name}/operations/{encoded}"),
                    )?;
    
                    if let Some(capability) = &method.required_capability {
                        let capability_dir =
                            builder.add_dir_idempotent(capabilities, &encode_component(capability))?;
                        builder.add_symlink(
                            capability_dir,
                            &format!("{plugin_name}.{}", encode_component(method_name)),
                            format!("/plugins/{plugin_name}/operations/{encoded}"),
                        )?;
                    }
                }
    
                let relation_dir = builder.add_dir(dependencies, &plugin_name)?;
                for dependency in &object.schema.dependencies {
                    builder.add_symlink(
                        relation_dir,
                        &encode_component(dependency),
                        format!("/plugins/{}", encode_component(dependency)),
                    )?;
                }
            }
    
            Ok(builder.finish())
        }

        /// Public mount declaration, never a credential or inferred identity.
        /// The caller supplies only the socket mount's declared session selector.
        pub(crate) fn declare_socket_session(&mut self, session: &str) -> Result<()> {
            let node = self
                .lookup(ROOT_INO, std::ffi::OsStr::new(".3tchedfs.json"))
                .context("mount metadata missing")?;
            let NodeKind::File(bytes) = &node.kind else {
                bail!("mount metadata is not a file")
            };
            let mut value: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes.read())?;
            value["session_id"] = Value::String(session.to_owned());
            let mut rendered = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&value)?;
            rendered.push(b'\n');
            *bytes.write() = rendered;
            Ok(())
        }

        #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
        fn add_value_children(

            field_schema: Option<&FieldSchema>,
            workspace_id: Option<&str>,

        ) -> Result<()> {
            let writable = inherited_writable
                && !pointer_is_immutable(plugin_schema, pointer, field_schema, value);
            match value {
                Value::Object(values) => {
                    if !pointer.is_empty() {
                        let target = write_target(workspace_id, plugin_id, pointer, writable);
                        if live && target.is_none() {
                            self.add_live_file(parent, ".value.json", plugin_id, pointer)?;
                        } else {

                    }

                        let child_schema = field_for_pointer(plugin_schema, field_schema, name);
                        let encoded = encode_component(name);
                        if value.is_object() || value.is_array() {
                            let directory = self.add_dir(parent, &encoded)?;
                            self.add_value_children(
                                directory,
                                plugin_id,
                                &child_pointer,
                                value,
                                plugin_schema,
                                child_schema,
                                workspace_id,
                                writable,
                                live,
                            )?;
                        } else {

                                && !pointer_is_immutable(

                                    &child_pointer,
                                    child_schema,
                                    value,

                                write_target(workspace_id, plugin_id, &child_pointer, child_writable);
                            if live && target.is_none() {
                                self.add_live_file(parent, &encoded, plugin_id, &child_pointer)?;
                            } else {
                                self.add_json(parent, &encoded, value, target)?;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                Value::Array(values) => {
                    let target = write_target(workspace_id, plugin_id, pointer, writable);
                    if live && target.is_none() {
                        self.add_live_file(parent, ".value.json", plugin_id, pointer)?;
                    } else {
                        self.add_json(parent, ".value.json", value, target)?;
                    }
                    for (index, value) in values.iter().enumerate() {
                        let name = format!("{index:08}");
                        let child_pointer = push_pointer(pointer, &index.to_string());
                        if value.is_object() || value.is_array() {
                            let directory = self.add_dir(parent, &name)?;
                            self.add_value_children(
                                directory,
                                plugin_id,
                                &child_pointer,
                                value,
                                plugin_schema,
                                field_schema,
                                workspace_id,
                                writable,
                                live,
                            )?;
                        } else {
                            let target =
                                write_target(workspace_id, plugin_id, &child_pointer, writable);
                            if live && target.is_none() {
                                self.add_live_file(parent, &name, plugin_id, &child_pointer)?;
